messages:
jana: Quick thread re: rollout plan for conversational-latency-optimizations. We want minimal customer surprise and clear rollback gates. Plan proposal below; comment fast please.

kevin: Suggest micro-canary sequence: dogfood 1% -> internal 3% -> public 3% ab vs control (even split) -> regionally staggered ramp. Keep 72h observation windows for public stages.

mei: Telemetry: p50/p95/p99 lat, 10m error rate, tokens-per-request, delta-cost. Add synthetic prompt set run every 30m for drift. Set alerting: p95>220ms 10m non-pager, p95>300ms 10m pager.

ryan: Fallback: first attempt soft-fallback to quant-variant in-region; second attempt route to eu-hosted-fallback if region degraded. Ensure session affinity for 12h after fallback. Add console kill switch and per-tenant opt-out toggle.

notif-bot: Rolling deploy scheduled: 2026-04-12 02:15 UTC -> 04:00 UTC. Pipeline tags: conv-latopt-v1.

jana: Owners: kevin (rollout flags + micro-canaries), mei (telemetry + alerting), ryan (fallback + session-affinity), eng-plat (deploy window). Reply "ack" when claimed.
